title: verify-stable-staker.sh relies on ANVIL_PRIVATE_KEY from .envrc but never exports it — npm test:stable-staker fails on a fresh clone / CI
description: verify-stable-staker.sh hardcodes and exports PRIVATE_KEY (anvil acct0) but the interaction scripts StakeStableStaker.s.sol and ClaimWithdrawStableStaker.s.sol read vm.envUint("ANVIL_PRIVATE_KEY") — a DIFFERENT variable the shell never exports. The flow only works because the repo-root .envrc (direnv) sets ANVIL_PRIVATE_KEY in the ambient shell. Confirmed empirically: with .envrc sourced the full flow passes green; with ANVIL_PRIVATE_KEY unset (env -u, keeping PRIVATE_KEY set as the shell would) STEP 1 reverts immediately: 'vm.envUint: environment variable "ANVIL_PRIVATE_KEY" not found'.
impact: The advertised one-command verification (npm run test:stable-staker) is not self-contained: any developer cloning fresh, or any CI runner, that does not load the repo-root .envrc gets an immediate revert in STEP 1 before any staking — the smoke check cannot run. The script exports the wrong variable name, so the PRIVATE_KEY it does set is never consumed.
severityRationale: Test-harness / tooling defect with zero on-chain or asset impact — a variable-name mismatch (script exports PRIVATE_KEY; the interaction scripts read ANVIL_PRIVATE_KEY) that makes the advertised one-command smoke check non-self-contained: it reverts at STEP 1 on any fresh clone or CI runner that does not load the repo-root .envrc. This affects only the availability of a developer verification convenience, not the protocol, so it is well below the C4 Medium 'protocol function/availability' bar (the protocol is the deployed contracts, not the test script). It is a real, empirically-reproduced correctness/portability bug in tooling, which places it at Low rather than pure-informational QA: the script's exported variable is silently never consumed, and the hidden environment coupling will break CI deterministically. No security dimension.
evidence: verify-stable-staker/side-effects.json negativeTest: revertReason 'vm.envUint: environment variable "ANVIL_PRIVATE_KEY" not found'. Shell exports PRIVATE_KEY (line 21) not ANVIL_PRIVATE_KEY; scripts read ANVIL_PRIVATE_KEY (StakeStableStaker.s.sol:33, ClaimWithdrawStableStaker.s.sol:29).
recommendation: Either export ANVIL_PRIVATE_KEY in verify-stable-staker.sh (export ANVIL_PRIVATE_KEY="$PRIVATE_KEY"), or change the interaction scripts to read PRIVATE_KEY. Aligning the names removes the hidden .envrc dependency and makes the smoke check runnable from a clean checkout / CI.
